# Callouts demo

---

## Callouts

## Default type (note)

> [!note]
> Example content.

## Custom title

> [!note] Custom Title Here
> Example content.

## Multi-paragraph

> [!note] Long callout
> First paragraph.
>
> Second paragraph with **formatting**.

## Nested markdown (bold and list)

> [!tip]
> Example content with **bold text**.
>
> - Item one
> - Item two
> - Item three

## Nested callout

> [!note] Outer callout
> Outer content.
>
> > [!tip] Inner callout
> > Inner content.
